title: Buying locally
bodyMd: A school district proposes buying vegetables from nearby farms. Transport distances would be shorter, but the procurement officer warns that distance alone does not determine environmental impact: production methods, refrigeration, and vehicle loads also matter. The district still values supporting local suppliers and plans to compare complete supply chains before making an environmental claim. It does not claim that local food is necessarily worse.
